bodyDescription: Voskes Chicken Soup is a tasty snack that encourages cats to drink more and promotes hydration. If cats do not drink enough, there is a risk of urolithiasis. Cats on a dry food diet are particularly susceptible. Voskes Chicken Soup is completely grain-free and contains no added salt. Can be given separately as a drink or added to dry food for extra flavour, ideal for picky cats!
